summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing of Estoque (PT-BR inventory app). 15/15 backend pytest tests passed covering auth (register/login/me/dup-phone/wrong-pass), catalog (5 stores, 4 categories, products by category), and orders (create em_via, list filtered by store/status, receive marks recebido + records received_by, double-receive 400, missing-token 401, invalid store 400, empty cart 400, receive-nonexistent 404). Frontend mobile E2E passed via Playwright on viewport 390x844: registered new user, navigated PEDIR Castelo > Secos, used qty +/- (2x Arroz + 1x Açúcar), opened cart, confirmed order. Switched to RECEBER, saw Castelo badge '1 pedido(s) em via', tapped pedido, Confirmar Recebimento removed it from list (now 'Nenhum pedido em via'). All testIDs present and screens render with proper Brazilian-Portuguese copy. No red screens, no API errors in backend logs.

ui_bugs.issue: Duplicate testID 'goto-cart-fab' used in two screens. Both screens render simultaneously inside the Stack (Categorias FAB stays mounted while Produtos is on top), so a selector matching [data-testid=goto-cart-fab] resolves to 2 elements. Functionally fine but breaks unique-selector testing convention. Recommend renaming to 'goto-cart-fab-categorias' and 'goto-cart-fab-produtos'.

issues: Console emits deprecation warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow) - originates from FAB shadow styles in pedir/categorias.tsx and pedir/produtos.tsx; cosmetic only.
Console: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' from one of the lucide icons / RN-web layer; not breaking.

action_items: (LOW) Rename duplicate testID 'goto-cart-fab' so each screen has a unique testID (e.g., 'goto-cart-fab-produtos', 'goto-cart-fab-categorias').
(OPTIONAL) Replace deprecated shadow* style props with boxShadow on FAB and confirm buttons to silence console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend code is clean: bcrypt for passwords, JWT 30d expiry, Mongo ObjectId excluded from responses, pydantic validation, unique index on phone, idempotent product seeding, CORS open with allow_credentials, proper 400/401/404 status codes.

Frontend uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL correctly, axios interceptor injects Bearer token from AsyncStorage, all interactive elements have testID, View/Text/TouchableOpacity used (no raw HTML), StyleSheet.create everywhere, KeyboardAvoidingView on auth screens.
Cart context resets items on store change which prevents mixed-store carts.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all critical flows: register, login screen, home, PEDIR end-to-end, RECEBER end-to-end)

seed_data_creation: Two test users registered during the run (TEST_UserA, TEST_UserB via API tests, plus one TesterFlow via UI). Phones use millisecond-based unique values prefixed with 11. Backend auto-seeds 25 products on first startup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend at https://estoque-simples.preview.emergentagent.com/api with JWT Bearer auth. Stores: Castelo, Mesc, Delivery, Baeta, Producao. Categories: Secos, Geladeira, Limpeza, Embalagens. Use phone like 11<9 unique digits>. testIDs: login-screen, login-phone-input, login-password-input, login-submit-button, goto-register, register-{name|phone|password}-input, register-submit-button, home-screen, home-username, action-pedir, action-receber, logout-btn, pedir-lojas-screen, store-{StoreId}, pedir-categorias-screen, category-{Cat}, pedir-produtos-screen, product-{id}-{increment|decrement|qty}, goto-cart-fab (DUPLICATE - present on both categorias and produtos screens, use .last() in Playwright), carrinho-screen, cart-item-{pid}, cart-remove-{pid}, confirm-order-btn, receber-lojas-screen, receber-store-{StoreId}, receber-pedidos-screen, order-card-{id}, order-receive-{id}. RN Alert on web does not auto-execute OK callback when accepted via Playwright dialog handler; the order is still created though, so to verify order creation re-load page or check via /api/orders.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no functional bugs found. The only flagged item is duplicate testID, which is a cosmetic test-affordance issue (both FABs share the same testID since one mounts while still on Categorias and the other on Produtos).
